files.README.md: The endpoint lists active records. No workload, latency or throughput target has been decided.
files.src/endpoint.ts: export function list(records) { return records.filter(r => r.active).map(r => ({id:r.id})); }
files.tests/endpoint.test.ts: // Functional requirement: only active records are returned.

files.AGENTS.md: Public API backwards compatibility is mandatory. Existing status codes and named fields must remain unchanged. Do not ask whether compatibility matters.

files.README.md: Accounts are stored with id and email. No soft-delete, permanent-erasure, retention or recovery policy has been defined.
files.src/accounts.ts:
export const accounts = new Map();
export function findAccount(id) { return accounts.get(id); }

files.AGENTS.md: An event is a duplicate exactly when its id equals an existing event id. Keep the existing record and public API unchanged. This bugfix has no product decisions to resolve.
files.tests/events.test.ts:
// Acceptance: inserting id=x twice returns a single unchanged original event.
assert.deepEqual(insertEvent([{id:"x",value:1}],{id:"x",value:2}),[{id:"x",value:1}]);

files.README.md: Workspace records already exist in persistent storage. No owner backfill or default value policy is defined.
files.src/workspaces.ts:
// Persistent existing schema: workspaces(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL)
export function workspace(row) { return {id:row.id,name:row.name}; }
